name: WoodenPlatLoad
meaning: WoodenPlatForm::GetLoad's answer 0x50b5f4, the index into WoodenPlatForm.targetY: what stands on the platform (verified in its code)

name: WPLAT_LOAD_EMPTY
meaning: nothing counted: targetY[0], the rest height (the start pos.y)

name: WPLAT_LOAD_SHEEP
meaning: a sheep (CLASSID_SHEEP) and no heavier object: targetY[1], halfway

name: WPLAT_LOAD_HEAVY
meaning: Ralph (CLASSID_WOLF) or a rock (CLASSID_ROCK), returned at once: targetY[2], -MINZVALUE
